items.quote: Microprobe measurements were performed at the Swedish Institute for Metals Research. The apparatus used was a S.E.M.Q.(A.R.L) microprobe. The acceleration potential was 20 KV. The analysis of Fe and Ni was based upon the Ka radiation but La radiation was used for W. Pure elements were adopted as standards.
The temperature measurements were performed by using a Pt-Pt 10 pct Rh thermocouple. The temperature variations during the heat treatment were less than 5 K.
